entities.summary: Kompayak Porpramook is a Thai professional boxer in the light flyweight and flyweight divisions. He is the former World Boxing Association (WBA) interim flyweight champion and former World Boxing Council (WBC) light flyweight champion. Kompayak Porpramook became the second Thai to capture the WBC light flyweight title, following Saman Sorjaturong in the 1990s.
